title: Restriction commutes with finite gate evaluation
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, choose an AND or OR gate, a finite set of input indices among $m$ indices, and a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube for each input index. For any set $J$ of coordinates and any fixed signs outside $J$, restricting the function obtained by applying the gate to the selected input functions gives the same function as first restricting each input function and then applying the gate to the same selected inputs.
hypotheses_covered: the gate is either AND or OR
each of the $m$ inputs is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
the selected inputs form a finite subset of the $m$ indices
$J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
